body: Exploration + brainstorm phase only, no code. Original request (2026-10-02, Aman Bansal): build a flexible, pluggable, extensible filesystem package in Go with adapters and contrib modules, so it is the only filesystem package any Go app needs. Research what web/mobile/SaaS/social apps need from storage, so the package ships batteries-included. References: ubgo/auth (architecture template). Metadata store uses github.com/ubgo/sqlb.
title: Explore and design ubgo/filesystem: the one storage package every Go app needs
